Staff

Instructors

Joey Gonzalez

he/him

jegonzal@berkeley.edu

Office Hours: Tuesdays from 1:30 to 3:00 in Soda 773 and on Zoom

Joey is the director of the RISE and Sky Labs, member of the Berkeley AI Research (BAIR) group, and co-founder of Turi and Aqueduct. He developed and teaches Data100 and this is his first time teaching Data8. If you see him outside of campus, he is almost always playing with his kids.

Swupnil Sahai

he/him

swupnil@berkeley.edu

Office Hours: Mondays, 4-6pm @ FSM Cafe

Swupnil is a 2013 Cal grad, CEO of SwingVision, and 7th-time lecturer of Data 8 🤓 Previously, he led object tracking at Tesla A.I. ⚡ If he’s not at Wheeler, you can catch him traveling, hiking or playing tennis 🎾
